summary: A Quote subscription on an NSE equity: the 102-byte detailed packet becomes a Quote frame with every quote field.

notes: The web's detailed frame sends no change, bid/ask or 52-week fields though the packet carries them (pocketful_adapter.py:581-598); the desktop does not send them either.

deviations.reason: Pocketful sends the last trade time in epoch seconds and the web passes the seconds on as ltt; the desktop sends epoch milliseconds, the unit the docs give every WebSocket time (decisions 2026-11-09: ltt in seconds -> ms, a web defect, wrong unit).

The desktop sends Pocketful's change key from LTP up (names.rs `from`), in Quote and Depth frames too; the Pocketful web adapter sends change only in its LTP (compact) frame. Open until wire's WebName.to.

The desktop sends the canonical last_quantity beside last_trade_quantity; the Pocketful web adapter sends last_trade_quantity only, which is also the docs' name (lead ruling 2026-11-09). Open until wire's per-broker rule for canonical keys (each key's mode range or never, index and non-index apart; lead 2026-11-09).

The desktop sends the canonical price_change and price_change_percent on an instrument beside the web adapter's own change keys (change); the adapter sends no price_change, which is not a docs key, so it goes. Open until wire's per-broker rule for canonical keys (each key's mode range or never, index and non-index apart; lead 2026-11-09).
